recognize_zh: 這是右髖關節與股骨近端 X 光片（非型態圖）：股骨近端與骨盆骨質普遍稀疏，股骨幹與轉子區出現多發性、邊界清楚、無周邊硬化的溶骨性病灶（punched-out lytic lesions）與皮質內側侵蝕，是多發性骨髓瘤的典型骨骼影像。
features: Frontal radiograph of the right hip and proximal femur
Diffuse osteopenia of the pelvis and proximal femur
Multiple small, well-defined lucent (lytic) lesions without sclerotic rims in the femoral shaft and trochanteric region
Endosteal scalloping/thinning of the femoral cortex
No periosteal reaction or displaced pathologic fracture visible
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic image: a frontal radiograph of the right hip and proximal femur. There is diffuse osteopenia with multiple well-defined, punched-out lytic lesions lacking sclerotic margins in the proximal femoral shaft and trochanteric region, with endosteal cortical scalloping. No periosteal reaction or obvious displaced fracture is seen. Multiple non-sclerotic lytic lesions with osteopenia are characteristic of multiple myeloma bone disease and indicate risk for pathologic fracture; lesions are typically cold on bone scan, so skeletal survey, low-dose whole-body CT or PET-CT is preferred for staging.
